uncertainty: The value of khrak-khrik and the omitted third-ground quantity remain unverified.

problem: The tenth-ground quantity lacks an explicit counted cosmic unit; the last item’s ལུང་རིག is anomalous in a list of retinues. U03683 contains repeated tshegs.

uncertainty: A defective final item is probable; the correct reading is unknown.
